statement: You are given an array nums of integers.
Decide whether nums can be split into two groups with equal sums, where every element goes into exactly one of the groups.
Return true if such a split exists and false otherwise.

examples.explanation: Split it into [1, 5, 5] and [11]. Both groups sum to 11.
The total is 11, which is odd, so it cannot be divided into two equal integer halves.
